$comment: The front page's categories: the chips a visitor filters the families by, and which archetypes (content/story/personas.json) each one holds. Authored. An archetype is in exactly one category; checked by scripts/story/lib/categories.mts (story:validate, scripts/test-categories.mts). A chip with no current family is not drawn (scripts/portal-front.mts). The category id is also the filter value (?persona=), so it never equals an archetype id. typeFilters are the second filter, the kind of place; no persona is tied to one. Labels are sentence case, at most 18 characters; blurbs are at most 20 words and end with a full stop.

categories.label: Work from home
categories.blurb: Desk work done from a spare room or kitchen table: briefs, clients, sources and deadlines.

categories.label: Run a business
categories.blurb: Shops, trades and stalls run from a garage, a back room or a small office.

categories.label: Code and tinker
categories.blurb: Writing software and running the house network, with the local model on the Core.

categories.label: Study and research
categories.blurb: Homework, lesson plans, papers and sources, for pupils, teachers and anyone chasing a question.

categories.label: Make and keep
categories.blurb: Painting, design, music and photographs, and the family archive that outlives the project.

categories.label: Play and explore
categories.blurb: Games, collections, training logs and trips: the hours kept for fun, and the record of them.

categories.label: Run the household
categories.blurb: Paperwork, shared costs and a week that different people live on different clocks.

categories.label: Host and care
categories.blurb: Feeding the house, looking after a relative, and keeping a club or committee going.
